description: UNI-2567 items 7 and 8. Declares, per required CI check, which test suites constitute REQUIRED_EVIDENCE and which capabilities the check must positively prove. A suite that exists but executed zero tests is not evidence, however green the job concluded. Consumed by scripts/ci-evidence-manifest.mjs, which reads vitest JSON reporter output and resolves commit provenance from the GitHub Actions API.

classes.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Zero execution fails the completeness check.
classes.ALLOWED_NON_BLOCKING: Zero execution is recorded but does not fail the completeness check.

notes.requiredCapabilities: The coverage floor, and the part that survives a rename. Each listed capability must be carried by at least one REQUIRED_EVIDENCE suite that actually executed. Deleting or relabelling a suite fails for absence of proof rather than for failing to match a name pattern.

prerequisite.note: Absent from the repository secret store as at 16/08/2026, which is why every integration suite below self-skips. UNI-2567 item 5 (fail-closed preflight) and the SPINE_DATABASE_URL provisioning decision are both out of scope for this check and remain open.
